label: Northern-style -r
description: Pronunciation: This course often uses northern-influenced 儿化 (érhuà), especially 一点儿 (yìdiǎnr), 哪儿 (nǎr), 这儿 (zhèr), 那儿 (nàr) and 一会儿 (yíhuìr). A small Northern-style -r marker identifies affected expressions. These are not exclusive to northern China; alternative forms vary by word and context. The ending -r is not an additional spoken syllable.

expressions.hanzi: 我们在这儿吃还是在那儿吃？
expressions.pinyin: Wǒmen zài zhèr chī háishi zài nàr chī?
expressions.note: Northern-leaning rhotic style; these forms can also be valid Standard Mandarin and are not geographically exclusive.
